name: Gargoyleosaurus
isnote: Treated as an early nodosaurid in the cited revision; polacanthid placement is disputed, so it is placed in Ankylosauria.
sum: Gargoyleosaurus is an early armoured ankylosaur from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of Wyoming, known from a skull and partial skeleton.
holotype: Most of the skull and a partial postcranial skeleton, found in 1995 at Bone Cabin Quarry West — Morrison Formation, Albany County, Wyoming; held by the Denver Museum of Nature and Science.
material: Two other partial skeletons are known but undescribed.
biology: Early ankylosaur with armour including plates; the sources used give no behavioural data.
author: Carpenter et al. 1998
